_note: Beispiele aus getesteten Iterationen (7. Sep 2026) — nur als Illustration des Baukastens, nicht 1:1 wiederverwenden. Jedes neue Motiv bekommt eigene Werte.

style.genre: casual amateur smartphone mirror selfie, fast everyday snapshot
style.post_processing: completely unedited, straight out of camera, natural smartphone image processing, ordinary washed-out colors

subject.description: muscular young man in his mid-20s, athletic believable build, black tank top
subject.state: sweat on forehead and shoulders, chalk dust on his flexed hand
subject.pose: right arm raised and bent at a right angle, fist beside his head, biceps fully flexed
subject.expression: confident closed-mouth smirk, looking at the mirror

environment.location: alone in a corner of a commercial gym
environment.background: a few blurred gym-goers far in the background, faces indistinct
environment.props: workout bag and water bottle on the rubber floor nearby

camera.device: an iPhone 15 Pro in black, back facing the mirror
camera.logo: small glossy chrome Apple logo silhouette etched directly onto the glass, catching the light like polished metal, with no circle or ring or plate around it
camera.handling: phone held low at chest height, only two fingertips wrap around the lower edge, the rest hidden behind the phone; phone and hand partly cut off by the bottom edge of the frame

composition.framing: subject slightly off-center and slightly tilted, mirror edge and part of a dumbbell rack cut off at the frame edge
composition.focus: slightly soft focus, slight motion blur on the raised arm

lighting.source: only the gym's overhead fluorescent panels plus daylight from large windows
lighting.quality: harsh flat light, strong unflattering shadows under the jaw and eyes, slight overexposure near the windows

texture.skin: natural skin texture with visible pores, light sweat sheen
texture.grain: visible digital noise in the shadows

style.genre: casual candid smartphone photo taken by a diner right before eating
style.post_processing: unedited, straight out of camera, natural smartphone image processing, slight digital noise, ordinary colors

subject.description: a large Wiener Schnitzel with golden-brown crispy breaded crust, subtle sheen of frying oil, and golden french fries on a simple white plate
subject.details: one lemon wedge on top, a fork resting loosely on the plate edge

environment.location: casual Austrian restaurant, plain wooden table, daylight with ordinary mixed indoor lighting
environment.props: glass of soda with condensation, half-full small beer, paper napkin holder, used knife next to the plate, edge of a companion's plate with dumplings in the corner
environment.background: blurred diners far in the background near the windows

camera.angle: close-up 45-degree angle from the diner's own point of view
camera.handling: nothing styled, no people's hands or faces visible in the frame

composition.framing: slightly tilted, a bit of the table in the lower frame

lighting.source: restaurant daylight with ordinary mixed indoor lighting

constraints: no text and no logos in the image
